K/DA.effect: Collect 4 K/DA Cards to gain an extra augment.
K/DA.tip: An extra augment is more valuable on scaling champions: collect the cards.

HEARTSTEEL.effect: Augments can have unique modifiers that make them stronger.
HEARTSTEEL.tip: Read the modifier before choosing: it can make a lower-tier augment better than a higher-tier one.

True Damage.effect: Takedowns and destroyed towers can drop Anvils for the team.
True Damage.tip: Early fights and tower pressure bring Stat Anvils: play for takedowns.

Pentakill.effect: One of your abilities becomes stronger at the start of the match and again at level 18.
Pentakill.tip: Choose the ability you use most often for damage or crowd control.

Disco.effect: Dance under the disco ball to grant gold to your entire team.
Disco.tip: Gold for everyone: use the disco ball when it is safe.

Cafe Cuties.tip: Collect health relics during extended fights; their healing matters more.

Bees.effect: Collect honey pots and avoid the bees flying around the map.
Bees.tip: Avoid bees during fights; collect honey when it is safe.

Command Line.effect: At each selection, you can reroll an augment into a higher-tier one.
Command Line.tip: Use the reroll on the slot your champion depends on rather than a filler slot.
